message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays that Canadians can expect in 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Monday, or a holiday that is observed on a Monday when the actual date lands on a weekend, giving you a 3‑day break.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Province(s) where it’s a statutory holiday | Long‑weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------------------------------|---------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Mon | AB, SK, ON, NB, MB, PE (and a few others) | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Fri | All provinces | ✔ | Friday + Sat‑Sun = 3‑day weekend. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Mon | All provinces | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Sat | All provinces | ✔* | Since it falls on a Saturday, the holiday is observed on **Mon Jul 3**.  You get Sat‑Sun‑Mon. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Mon | All provinces | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Mon | All provinces | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Mon | All provinces | ✔ | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tue | All provinces | ✘ | Tuesday only – no long weekend (unless you take a day off). |

### Provincial‑specific notes

| Holiday | Province | Observation rule | Long‑weekend status |
|---------|----------|------------------|---------------------|
| **Family Day** | AB, SK, ON, NB, MB, PE | Monday in February | ✔ |
| **Remembrance Day** | BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, PE, NL, NS, PE | Saturday (or observed Monday in some provinces) | ✘ (unless observed Monday) |
| **Other holidays** | e.g., St. Patrick’s Day (NB), St. George’s Day (PE) | Not statutory holidays | ✘ |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • Store the holiday dates per province.  
> • Flag holidays that fall on a Monday or are observed on a Monday.  
> • For holidays that fall on a weekend, check the “observed” date (e.g., Canada Day → Jul 3).  

Feel free to let me know if you need the data in a specific format (CSV, JSON, etc.) or if you’d like a full list of all statutory holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends).
